correctness.rationale: From any initial state the no-reset branch has mass e^(−rt); the remaining branch is the channel average over ages 0 to t. This proves the stationary Laplace integral and trace-norm convergence independently of the initial state. Tensorized depolarization multiplies the sole GHZ coherence by e^(−nγt) and gives equal populations for complementary words. The exact general X-state GM concurrence formula gives max(0,2c+2d_0−1) upon summing unordered non-GHZ complementary pairs. The reference in RESULT.md points to the appendix's Eq. (13), a restricted block lemma; the general theorem used here is Sec. II, Eq. (5), and does apply. The age variable Z has E[Z^j]=ρ/(ρ+j); expanding the endpoint populations produces precisely the even-binomial sum. Its j=0 value is 1; each term is nondecreasing in ρ, and the separate ρ/(ρ+n) term is strictly increasing. Continuity and endpoint values 2^(1−n)−1 and 1 give exactly one positive threshold. Direct combination of the rational terms gives the n=3 and n=4 checks. Independently, express the binomial sum as E[ρ/(ρ+J)] for J~Bin(n,1/2) conditioned even. For n>4 its first four moments equal the unconditioned ones, by vanishing alternating sums of polynomials of degree <n. Taylor expansion about n/2 uses mean-zero centered first and third moments, variance n/4, and fourth moment O(n²); the fourth derivative is O(n⁻⁴) uniformly on J≥0 for ρ=cn+d with c bounded away from 0 and bounded d. This yields 2c/(2c+1)+[2d/(2c+1)²+2c/(2c+1)³]/n+O(n⁻²) for the binomial term. Adding the separate term gives leading zero c=1/sqrt(2) and canceling the 1/n coefficient gives d=−1/2+sqrt(2)/4. The rational derivative on this scale is at least n/(ρ+n)², so an O(n⁻²) residual locates the root to O(n⁻¹), by bracketing a distance O(n⁻¹) around cn+d.
residual_risks: The incorrect equation locator in the frozen citation is bibliographic, not a missing theorem. The criterion is for unconditioned stationary genuine concurrence, and cannot be transferred to conditioned trajectories or independent reset clocks.

value.rationale: This gives an exact full-system reset overhead for maintaining a standard genuinely multipartite resource against independent isotropic local noise. A one-cut entanglement diagnostic would not answer that question. The all-size boundary, extensive coefficient and finite-size correction quantify what is required; the different scaling in the closest amplitude-damping comparator illustrates why the noise model matters. The value is a maintenance law using an entangled reset resource, not a protocol for creating GHZ entanglement from separable resets.
residual_risks: No conclusions about heterogeneous noise, noisy reset fidelity, implementation cost, or other entanglement diagnostics.
